# VARIANTS — every registered recipe, from the structures the trade layer executes (GENERATED by backtest.variants_doc)

Terms: [GLOSSARY.md](GLOSSARY.md). Regenerated every Part C run (register 116). **No hand-written numbers**: every value renders from `RECIPE_SETS['recipe_set_v0.8']` (backtest/recipes.py — the same structures, through the same normalize(), that simulate() executes), config.yaml, and the trade layer's scope constants; provenance strings are the recipe structures' own; authority trails cite [parameter_registry.md](parameter_registry.md). **TIMESTAMP CONVENTION (register 131, verified with a worked example): the journal's open_ts/close_ts are bar-CLOSE stamps — the simulate() time axis stamps each 1M bar by its close (Env.trail_ref derives a bar's open as ts − 1M), so the FILL is the OPEN of the bar that CLOSES at open_ts (the fire/trigger bar closes at open_ts − 1M). Enrichment MAE/MFE join on the same axis and are FILL-ANCHORED. Reading open_ts against the store's open-stamped bars mislocates the fill by one minute — the register-131 flag's anatomy.** ENFORCED: every variant in the journal has a section here or the suite fails (tests/test_variants_doc.py — the glossary pattern applied to strategies). Fill classes per register 65; nothing here re-grades anything.
